Now I have a thorough understanding of both the competitor landscape and Rankora's current implementation. Here is the complete gap analysis.

---

## Career Page Feature Gap Analysis: Rankora vs. Top ATS Platforms

### Current State of Rankora's Career Page

Rankora currently has a functional but minimal career page implementation:

**What exists today:**
- Public career page at `/careers/:slug` with company branding (name, logo, brand color, tagline, about section)
- Department filter (pill-based, single department at a time)
- Job listing cards showing title, location, department, employment type, salary range, posted date
- "Apply Now" button per job, linking to `/apply/:jobId`
- Application form: name (required), email (required), phone (optional), resume upload (optional, drag-and-drop), LinkedIn URL (optional)
- Application management tab: status tracking (pending/reviewed/shortlisted/rejected), resume download, real-time updates via Supabase subscription
- Career settings page: company name, URL slug (with availability check), logo URL, brand color, tagline, about text, publish toggle, job publish toggles
- "Powered by Rankora" footer
- Slug validation and uniqueness enforcement at DB level

---

### Competitor Feature Breakdown

#### 1. Manatal Career Page

**Source:** [Manatal Career Page Builder](https://www.manatal.com/features/career-page), [Manatal Advanced Career Page Blog](https://www.manatal.com/blog/advanced-career-page)

- Custom domain hosting (e.g., careers.yourcompany.com)
- Multiple theme templates with modern visual designs
- Custom favicon and social media thumbnails (OG images)
- Custom application forms with mandatory/optional fields, dropdowns, open questions
- Job search by keyword
- Filter by city/country, department/organization, industry
- Advanced job-to-post linking (one job to multiple posts for multi-location, or consolidate many jobs into one post)
- Automatic candidate parsing and AI scoring on application
- Google Analytics integration
- Google Tag Manager support
- Conversion tracking (started vs completed applications)
- Career Page API for embedding on external sites
- CMS compatibility (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace)
- SEO-optimized pages with keyword integration
- Multilingual support (create pages in any language)
- No-code builder (no technical skills required)

#### 2. Greenhouse Career Page

**Source:** [Greenhouse Integration Options](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/200721644-Choose-a-careers-page-integration-option), [Greenhouse Job Board Customization](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/18996861758363-Customize-your-job-board), [Greenhouse Google for Jobs](https://support.greenhouse.io/hc/en-us/articles/115003185526-Job-post-visibility-on-Google-for-Jobs)

- Five integration tiers: hosted board, embedded iFrame, API-driven with hosted apps, API-driven with custom apps, fully custom API
- Job Board API providing JSON for jobs, offices, departments
- Drop-down filters by department, office, and custom fields
- Schema.org JobPosting structured data for Google for Jobs visibility
- Structured job post locations (offices + custom location lists)
- Logo upload and rich-text formatting on job posts
- Custom application questions and fields per job
- Embeddable job board (iFrame widget for external websites)
- WordPress plugin for Greenhouse job boards
- ADA compliance AA+ capability (in full custom tier)
- Tracking pixels and source tracking
- Spam prevention mechanisms
- Available across all subscription tiers (Core, Plus, Pro)

#### 3. Lever Career Page

**Source:** [Lever Job Sites](https://www.lever.co/lever-job-site/), [Lever Career Site Builder](https://www.lever.co/career-site-builder/), [Lever HTML Widget](https://help.lever.co/hc/en-us/articles/20087269502237-Career-Site-Builder-HTML-widget)

- Career Site Builder (paid add-on) with drag-and-drop editor
- Site Theme panel: customize text, buttons, images, backgrounds, navigation across entire site
- Widget library: social sharing buttons, multimedia, contact forms, HTML/CSS embeds
- "Keep in Touch" form for general interest candidates (talent pool collection)
- Google Analytics integration for traffic and engagement tracking
- Internal vs external candidate pathways (separate experiences)
- Custom branding: fonts, colors, imagery
- Schema.org structured data and OG/Twitter Card metadata
- Custom HTML widget for embedding third-party content (videos, forms)
- Responsive design (mobile-optimized)
- SEO metadata (page-level)
- New Relic browser monitoring
- Employee referral programs and internal mobility support

#### 4. Workable Career Page

**Source:** [Workable Careers Pages](https://www.workable.com/features/careers-pages), [Workable Careers Page Builder](https://help.workable.com/hc/en-us/articles/360052322194-Managing-the-Careers-page-site-builder), [Workable Job Widget](https://help.workable.com/hc/en-us/articles/115012801727-How-to-embed-jobs-on-your-website-job-widget)

- Drag-and-drop page builder with templated sections:
  - Header and Footer (required)
  - List of Jobs (required, with optional search)
  - Image with Text
  - Paragraph
  - Testimonials (employee photos + quotes)
  - Image Gallery
  - Departments (dynamic, auto-updates)
  - Locations (office addresses)
  - Benefits (tile-based with icons)
  - Video (YouTube/Vimeo embed)
  - Numbers (key company figures)
  - Social Media links (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube)
- Job search bar (requires minimum 6 published jobs)
- Department filtering
- Talent Pool: general applications when no suitable job is found
- Google Analytics and tracking pixel integration
- Auto-source tracking for candidates
- Embeddable job widget (JavaScript snippet) with CSS/JS customization hooks
- Widget displays jobs by location or department
- WordPress plugin for embedding
- Custom domain hosting (via account manager)
- Mobile-responsive design
- Invite team members to edit (non-technical editor access)
- Undo/redo in editing sessions
- Social sharing buttons (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn)
- GDPR/EEO compliance info auto-included in footer
- Multilingual page support

#### 5. BambooHR Career Page

**Source:** [BambooHR ATS](https://www.bamboohr.com/platform/applicant-tracking-system/), [BambooHR Review](https://juicebox.ai/blog/bamboohr-reviews)

- Basic career page with minimal customization (weakest of the five)
- Job posting creation and distribution to free boards (Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter)
- Social media channel posting
- Custom job descriptions with qualifications and branding
- Customizable offer letter templates with auto-populated candidate details
- E-signatures for offer acceptance
- Mobile app support
- No advanced page builder (generic page, limited branding)
- No dynamic content, video testimonials, or section-based builder
- Integration with external job boards and sourcing tools via marketplace

---

### Feature Comparison Matrix

| Feature | Manatal | Greenhouse | Lever | Workable | BambooHR | **Rankora (Current)** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Custom domain** | Yes | N/A (embed) | Yes | Yes (via AM) | No | **No** |
| **Theme templates** | Yes (multiple) | No (custom CSS) | Yes (builder) | Yes (sections) | No | **No (single layout)** |
| **Logo + brand color** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Limited | **Yes** |
| **Tagline / about section** | Yes | Via rich text | Yes | Yes (sections) | No | **Yes** |
| **Job search (keyword)** | Yes | No (filters only) | No | Yes (6+ jobs) | No | **No** |
| **Filter by department** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | **Yes (basic)** |
| **Filter by location** | Yes | Yes (office) | No specific | Via widget | No | **No** |
| **Filter by employment type** | No explicit | Custom fields | No | No | No | **No** |
| **Multiple filter combo** | Yes | Yes | No | Department only | No | **No** |
| **Custom application forms** | Yes (dropdowns, open Qs) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Basic | **No (fixed fields)** |
| **Resume upload** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | **Yes** |
| **Social sharing per job** | Via thumbnails | Social posting | Widget | Yes (FB/TW/LI) | Social posting | **No** |
| **Embed widget (external site)** | Yes (API) | Yes (iFrame/API) | Yes (HTML) | Yes (JS snippet) | No | **No** |
| **Google Analytics** | Yes | Via custom | Yes | Yes | No | **No** |
| **Conversion tracking** | Yes | Via custom | Yes | Yes (pixels) | No | **No** |
| **SEO structured data** | SEO-friendly | Schema.org JobPosting | Schema.org | No explicit | No | **No** |
| **OG / social meta tags** | Custom thumbnails | No explicit | OG + Twitter Cards | No explicit | No | **No** |
| **Talent pool / general apply** | No explicit | No | Yes ("Keep in Touch") | Yes (Talent Pool) | No | **No** |
| **Multilingual** | Yes | No | No | Yes | No | **No** |
| **Company culture sections** | No explicit | No | Yes | Yes (testimonials, gallery, benefits, video) | No | **No** |
| **Mobile responsive** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | **Yes** |
| **GDPR/compliance footer** | No explicit | No | No | Yes (auto) | No | **No** |
| **Custom favicon** | Yes | No | No | No | No | **No** |
| **Drag-and-drop builder** | No (form-based) | No | Yes | Yes | No | **No (form-based)** |
| **Candidate source tracking** | No explicit | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | **No** |
| **Internal vs external jobs** | No | Yes (boards) | Yes | No | No | **No** |
| **Application status tracking** | AI scoring | Workflows | Workflows | Workflows | Basic | **Yes (4 statuses)** |
| **Real-time application updates** | No explicit | No | No | No | No | **Yes (Supabase RT)** |

---

### Gap Analysis Summary

#### CRITICAL GAPS (Features in 4-5 competitors -- table stakes)

1. **Job search / keyword search** -- Manatal, Greenhouse (via API), Workable all offer keyword search. Candidates expect to be able to search open positions by keyword, especially when there are more than a handful of jobs.

2. **Location filter** -- Manatal, Greenhouse, Workable (via widget) all allow filtering by location/office. Rankora only has department filter. Location is equally important for candidates deciding whether to apply.

3. **Custom application form fields** -- Manatal, Greenhouse, Lever, Workable all allow adding custom questions to the application form (dropdowns, open-ended questions, required/optional toggles). Rankora has a fixed 5-field form with no customization.

4. **Embeddable job widget** -- Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Manatal all offer a way to embed job listings on external websites (company website, WordPress, etc.). This is how most companies actually use career pages -- embedded on their own domain. Rankora has zero embed capability.

5. **SEO: structured data (Schema.org JobPosting)** -- Greenhouse and Lever implement Schema.org JobPosting structured data. This is critical for appearing in Google for Jobs search results, which is a major candidate acquisition channel. Rankora has a SeoHead component but no job-specific structured data on career or apply pages.

6. **OG meta tags per job / career page** -- Lever implements OG and Twitter Card metadata. Manatal supports custom social thumbnails. When jobs are shared on LinkedIn/Twitter/Slack, they should show rich previews with job title, company, and description. Rankora has no per-page OG tags on career/apply routes.

7. **Google Analytics / tracking integration** -- Manatal, Lever, Workable, and Greenhouse (via custom) all support analytics tracking on career pages. Understanding which jobs get views, where traffic comes from, and application conversion rates is essential for employers. Rankora has no analytics on career pages.

8. **Social sharing buttons** -- Workable, Lever, and Manatal all enable candidates or recruiters to share individual jobs on social media platforms. This is a basic viral distribution mechanism. Rankora has no share buttons on job listings.

#### HIGH-PRIORITY GAPS (Features in 2-3 competitors -- strong differentiators)

9. **Talent pool / "Keep in Touch" form** -- Lever and Workable allow candidates who don't find a suitable role to leave their contact info for future opportunities. This captures interested talent that would otherwise be lost. Rankora shows "No open positions right now. Check back soon." with no way to capture interest.

10. **Company culture sections** -- Workable offers testimonials, image galleries, benefits tiles, video embeds, and stats sections. Lever supports multimedia widgets. These turn a job board into an employer branding page. Rankora only has a text-based tagline and about section.

11. **Custom domain support** -- Manatal, Lever, and Workable (via account manager) support hosting the career page on a custom subdomain (e.g., careers.acme.com). This builds trust and brand consistency. Rankora only supports `/careers/slug` on the Rankora domain.

12. **Conversion tracking** -- Manatal tracks "started vs completed" applications. Workable supports tracking pixels. Knowing your apply-page drop-off rate is essential for optimizing the funnel. Rankora has no funnel tracking.

13. **Multiple theme options** -- Manatal offers multiple themes. Workable has a section-based builder. Lever has a full page builder. Rankora has exactly one layout with color/logo customization only.

14. **GDPR/compliance notice** -- Workable auto-includes GDPR/EEO compliance information in the career page footer. With data protection regulations, this is increasingly expected. Rankora has no privacy notice on the career page or application form.

#### NICE-TO-HAVE GAPS (Features in 1-2 competitors -- future roadmap)

15. **Multilingual support** -- Manatal and Workable support creating career pages in different languages. Relevant for global companies but not MVP-critical.

16. **Internal vs external job boards** -- Greenhouse and Lever distinguish between internal-only and public-facing job boards. Enterprise feature, not MVP.

17. **Drag-and-drop page builder** -- Lever and Workable offer visual page builders. Significant engineering investment. Not MVP.

18. **Custom favicon** -- Manatal supports custom favicons. Minor branding detail.

19. **Candidate source tracking** -- Greenhouse, Lever, and Workable track where candidates came from (direct link, job board, social media, etc.). Valuable for marketing ROI analysis.

20. **Job description rich display** -- The current apply page shows the JD as plain whitespace-pre-line text. Competitors show structured JDs with sections (requirements, responsibilities, benefits, etc.).

---

### Prioritized Feature List

#### TIER 1: MVP Critical (Ship immediately -- directly impacts candidate acquisition and employer trust)

| Priority | Feature | Effort | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | **Job search (keyword)** | Low | Simple text filter on title/department/location. Every competitor has it. Essential when 5+ jobs exist. |
| P2 | **Location filter** | Low | Add location as second filter dimension alongside department. Data already exists in `jobs.location`. |
| P3 | **Social sharing buttons per job** | Low | Share to LinkedIn, Twitter/X, copy link. 3 buttons per job card. Takes 1-2 hours. Major distribution benefit. |
| P4 | **SEO structured data (Schema.org JobPosting)** | Medium | Add JSON-LD to career page and individual job/apply pages. Required for Google for Jobs visibility. Greenhouse and Lever both do this. |
| P5 | **OG meta tags per job** | Medium | Dynamic OG title, description, image for each job's apply page. Makes shared links show rich previews on LinkedIn/Slack/Twitter. |
| P6 | **GDPR / privacy notice** | Low | Add a brief data processing notice on the application form and a privacy link in the career page footer. Regulatory baseline. |

#### TIER 2: High Priority (Ship in next sprint -- closes key competitive gaps)

| Priority | Feature | Effort | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| P7 | **Custom application form fields** | Medium-High | Allow employers to add custom questions (text, dropdown, yes/no) to the apply form per job. Requires DB schema changes (custom_fields jsonb on jobs, responses jsonb on applications). Core ATS differentiator. |
| P8 | **Embeddable job widget** | Medium | JavaScript snippet that companies paste on their own website to show open positions. Generates inbound traffic. Greenhouse, Workable, Lever all have this. |
| P9 | **Google Analytics integration** | Low-Medium | Let employers input their GA4 measurement ID in career settings. Inject the gtag script on career/apply pages. |
| P10 | **Talent pool / general interest form** | Medium | When no jobs match or candidate wants to stay connected, show a "Stay in touch" form (name, email, resume). Store in a `talent_pool` table. |
| P11 | **Application conversion tracking** | Low-Medium | Track views vs applications per job. Simple counter columns or events table. Show in employer dashboard. |

#### TIER 3: Differentiators (Future sprints -- makes Rankora stand out)

| Priority | Feature | Effort | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| P12 | **Company culture sections** | High | Allow employers to add benefits tiles, team photos, video embeds, testimonials to the career page. Requires section-based content model. |
| P13 | **Embeddable apply form** | Medium | Allow the entire application form to be embedded on external sites, not just job listings. |
| P14 | **Custom domain support** | High | Allow CNAME mapping so career pages load on careers.company.com. Requires DNS verification and reverse proxy infrastructure. |
| P15 | **Job alert subscription** | Medium | "Get notified about new jobs" email signup. Interesting finding: [OpenJobRadar](https://openjobradar.com/) and [Scoutify](https://scoutify.com/) exist as third-party tools because most ATS platforms lack native job alerts. This is an underserved area. |
| P16 | **Candidate source tracking** | Low-Medium | Add UTM parameter parsing and referrer tracking on career/apply pages. Store source on application record. |
| P17 | **Multiple career page themes** | Medium-High | Offer 3-5 pre-built layout themes (minimal, corporate, startup, creative). |
| P18 | **Rich job description display** | Low-Medium | Parse or allow structured JD input (responsibilities, requirements, benefits, perks as separate sections) and display them with proper formatting on the apply page. |

#### TIER 4: Long-term / Enterprise (v3+)

| Priority | Feature | Effort | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| P19 | Multilingual career pages | High | i18n support for career page content. |
| P20 | Drag-and-drop page builder | Very High | Full WYSIWYG builder for career page layout. |
| P21 | Internal vs external job boards | Medium | Separate internal-only jobs visible to company employees. |
| P22 | A/B testing for job posts | High | Manatal supports multiple posts per job for A/B testing. |

---

### Unique Differentiator Opportunity

The single strongest differentiator Rankora could add that no competitor offers natively:

**AI-powered application scoring on the career page itself.** Rankora already has GPT-4o resume ranking infrastructure. When a candidate applies through the career page, their application could be automatically scored against the job description and the employer could see an AI match score alongside each application in real-time. This is what Manatal hints at with "automatic candidate parsing and AI scoring" but Rankora is positioned to do it better given its existing scoring pipeline.

The talent pool alert feature (P15) is also notably underserved. Third-party tools like OpenJobRadar and Scoutify exist specifically because ATS career pages lack native "notify me about new jobs" functionality. Building this natively would be a genuine differentiator.
